name: docket
description: A terminal tool that shows how long each GitHub issue and pull request has been waiting on its maintainers.
author: advl

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/docket src/application/main.ts
scripts.self-test: bun src/scripts/check-identity.ts --self-test && bun src/scripts/check-secrets.ts --self-test && bun src/scripts/check-audit.ts --self-test && bun src/scripts/check-licences.ts --self-test && bun src/scripts/check-structure.ts --self-test
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run build && bun run test:coverage && bun run self-test && bun run check:identity && bun run check:secrets && bun run check:audit && bun run check:licences && bun run check:structure
